purpose: Native facade re-authoring at true geographic frontage after v001 exposed severe nonuniform stretching/compression from OSM internal address boundaries.

critical_correction.combined_frontage_source: Use only the combined outer mapped west-Main outline.
critical_correction.internal_boundaries: Do NOT use per-address OSM polygon boundaries. They conflict with the verified modern facade photographs.

625-627.identity: One shared historic upper facade with two modern ground-floor storefronts.

upper_modules.end_pavilions: retain raised end masses and round parapet tablets

ground_modules.rule: Treat split as storefront composition, not a structural upper-facade division.

native_rebuild_rules: keep arch ends round at microcell resolution
keep six narrow center bays discrete
keep canopy as one continuous thin element
do not horizontally stretch signs or glazing

623.identity: Narrow Simply Charming storefront; should read much narrower than 621.
native_rebuild_rules: preserve strong vertical brick side piers

621.identity: Broad Carpets Plus facade with six tall upper openings and a wide modern storefront.

upper_modules.rule: Six separate vertical bays must remain readable; do not collapse into broad panels.

ground_modules.paired_entry: retain centered paired doors within main storefront

native_rebuild_rules: restore broad horizontal proportion relative to 623
keep purple sign band shallow and continuous

617-619.identity: Wide altered commercial facade with three boarded upper bays and irregular marquee.

upper_modules.rule: Three large upper bays, not three compressed pseudo-windows.

vertical_rules.base: Fit each facade to the accepted MicroGrade sidewalk elevation at its frontage.
vertical_rules.parapet: Keep photographed facade/parapet morphology; roof deck height does not define visible facade height.
vertical_rules.roof: Use LiDAR roof bands behind the facade. Do not force facade top to equal roof deck.
vertical_rules.micro_resolution: 16 cells per block for all facade module boundaries.

implementation_rules: Re-author each facade from module primitives at target width; do not nearest-neighbor scale completed facade cells.
Photo textures/material samples may be re-sampled locally inside a module, but architectural edges must come from this spec.
Preserve native glass now supported by Astra 0.7.0 where appropriate.
Keep total combined frontage exactly 729 microcells so the outer mapped frame remains locked.
Use the existing accepted photo studies as material/feature references, not as geometry blobs to stretch.

historical_module_corroboration.fact: Redfield Main Street was platted with 21-foot storefront allotments; some businesses used multiple lots and some building widths were reduced by walkways.
historical_module_corroboration.use: Corroborates a narrow 623 module and broader multi-module neighboring facades; not used as an exact cadastral boundary.
